result:
Renamed across all five source files that reference the field. Both builds and test suites pass.

**Changed:**
- `api/src/main/resources/graphql/order.graphqls:4` — schema field `totalAmount` → `grossAmount`
- `api/src/main/java/mn/shop/api/Order.java` — entity field and `getTotalAmount()` → `getGrossAmount()`
- `api/src/main/java/mn/shop/api/OrderDto.java` — record component and the call site in `of()`
- `web/src/lib/orders.ts` — the `ORDERS_QUERY` selection set and the `Order` interface
- `web/src/components/OrderSummary.tsx` — both read sites

Verified: `mvn -o test` → BUILD SUCCESS, 1 test passed; `npm run build` (tsc --noEmit) → clean; `npm test` → 1 passed.

**Two things I deliberately did not change, both worth your call:**

`web/src/generated/graphql-generated.ts:11` still says `totalAmount`. Its header says it's produced by graphql-codegen from `order.graphqls` and must not be hand-edited. But no codegen is actually wired up in this checkout — there's no codegen dependency or config, and `npm run build` is just `tsc --noEmit`, so nothing will regenerate it. Nothing imports the file either, which is why the typecheck stayed green. So it's currently a stale checked-in artifact that disagrees with the schema. Tell me which you want: run the real codegen, or I hand-edit the one line against the file's stated rule.

The JPA field rename also changes the implicitly mapped column from `total_amount` to `gross_amount`. There's no migration tooling, SQL, or `application.properties` in the repo, so there was nothing in-tree to update — but against an existing database this needs a migration, or a `@Column(name = "total_amount")` on the field to keep the old column. I didn't add either, since I can't see which you're on.

Also note the GraphQL schema change is breaking for any client outside this repo that still selects `totalAmount`. And the two test files mention `totalAmount` in comments explaining why they avoid asserting on that field name — that prose describes the rename itself, so I left it accurate as written.
